headline: Exploring the intersections of politics, economics, technology and the world around us.
subline: A personal archive of professional work, research, writing, experiments and photography.
shortIntro: My name is Houssam Mehfara, although I go by Sam. I'm Lebanese, trained in political studies and international relations, and interested in where politics, economics and technology meet.
bio: My name is Houssam Mehfara, although I go by Sam.

I am Lebanese, with an academic background in political studies and international relations. I studied Political Studies at the American University of Beirut, with minors in International Law, Human Rights and Transitional Justice.
I then pursued a Master's in International Relations at the Institut Barcelona d'Estudis Internacionals (IBEI), concentrating in International Political Economy.
I have lived, studied or worked across Beirut, Riyadh, Cairo, Paris and Barcelona.
